source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "public transport" AND (gender OR women OR informal OR everyday OR politics)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"public transport" AND (gender OR women OR informal OR everyday OR politics),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("public transport" AND ("everyday" OR "gender" OR "informal" OR "politics" OR "women"))
